answer: One defense is a hardware-bound identity card: each agent registers a TPM-backed key that cannot be copied. First, the agent proves its key lives in real silicon, not a script. Second, new identities start at zero reputation and must finish 50 verified micro-tasks to vote or earn. Third, misbehavior burns the deposit and blacklists the key forever. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips costing $420,000 plus 30 days of checks, while honest agents grow like a vine, each good deed sending a ripple of trust outward, and a prism of audits refracting every claim before it counts. - Jowy
